title: OpenAI为零前沿模型提供零数据保留选项
summary: OpenAI宣布为其符合条件的API客户提供零数据保留（Zero Data Retention）服务，并预览了私有安全处理（Private Safety Processing）功能。这一举措旨在平衡先进AI安全需求与数据隐私保护。零数据保留意味着OpenAI不会存储客户通过API提交的提示和输出数据，从而确保客户数据的完全隐私。私有安全处理则是一种新型的安全机制，允许OpenAI在不访问原始数据的情况下进行安全审查和模型行为监控，从而在不牺牲数据隐私的前提下提升AI安全性。该服务适用于前沿模型，体现了OpenAI对数据隐私和AI安全双重承诺。此举可能对依赖API的企业客户产生重要影响，尤其是那些对数据合规性有严格要求的企业。OpenAI通过技术手段实现了数据隐私与安全性的兼顾，为行业树立了新的标准。
summary_en: OpenAI has reaffirmed its Zero Data Retention policy for eligible API customers and previewed Private Safety Processing, a new mechanism that enables advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy. This initiative aims to balance the need for robust AI safety with strict data privacy requirements. Zero Data Retention ensures that OpenAI does not store customer prompts or outputs, while Private Safety Processing allows safety reviews and behavior monitoring without accessing raw data. This move is particularly significant for enterprise clients with stringent compliance needs and sets a new industry standard for privacy-preserving AI safety.
